2610.13128.title: Locate, Judge, Read: Role-Specialized Tool Agents over a Knowledge-Point Index for Open-Domain Multimodal Document QA
2610.13128.paper_summary: Question answering over large heterogeneous document collections requires first finding the right passages and then reading them, yet current retrieval-augmented agents give one model both kinds of tools and let it schedule itself. We present KnowForge, a pipeline separated by job: a hybrid-retrieval knowledge-point index; a Locator agent that can only search; a code-scheduled bridge judge that forces the missing second hop; a typed, size-bounded evidence pool that merges every search's ranking; a Deep Reader agent that can only read text, images and tables; and a synthesizer with a format checker. With a self-hosted Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (3B active), KnowForge reaches F1 47.5 on the full open-domain M3DocVQA (2,441 questions, 3,368 PDFs), +11.0 over the published M3DocRAG system and +7.1 over one-shot retrieve-and-answer on the same index and model, and 53.5 with DeepSeek-V4-Flash. On MultiHop-RAG it reaches 73.5 accuracy, above the strongest published RAG and GraphRAG results (71.2); on the single-document MMLongBench-Doc it lifts the same model from 34.8 to 47.0, level with GPT-4o reading page images (46.3). Per-job ablations on the full benchmarks attribute the gain: the Deep Reader is worth 3.8, 9.8 and 0 points on the three corpora, tracking how visual each is; merging both agents into one with all tools and twice the rounds loses 1.9 F1 because it keeps searching instead of reading; a round-budget sweep shows a step at four Locator rounds and a plateau beyond; query latency scales with model calls rather than corpus size. We serve the three indexed benchmarks as read-only knowledge bases (free registration) and release all prompts and the runner code: https://github.com/metask-ai/knowforge-bench
2610.13128.paper_summary_zh: 問題回答涉及大型異質文件集合，首先需要找到正確的段落，然後再進行閱讀，然而目前的檢索增強代理給予一個模型兩種工具並讓其自行安排。我們提出了 KnowForge，一個按任務分隔的管道：一個混合檢索知識點索引；一個只能搜索的定位代理；一個強制缺失第二步驟的代碼調度橋接評判；一個合併每次搜索排名的類型、大小受限的證據池；一個只能閱讀文本、圖像和表格的深度閱讀代理；以及一個帶有格式檢查器的綜合器。使用自托管的 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B（3B 活躍），KnowForge 在完整的開放領域 M3DocVQA（2,441 個問題，3,368 個 PDF）上達到 F1 47.5，比已發表的 M3DocRAG 系統高出 11.0，比同一索引和模型的一次性檢索和回答高出 7.1，並且在 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 上達到 53.5。在 MultiHop-RAG 上，它達到 73.5 的準確率，超過了最強已發表的 RAG 和 GraphRAG 結果（71.2）；在單文檔 MMLongBench-Doc 上，它將相同模型從 34.8 提升到 47.0，與 GPT-4o 閱讀頁面圖像（46.3）持平。對完整基準的每項任務消融分析歸因於增益：深度閱讀器在三個語料庫中分別價值 3.8、9.8 和 0 分，追蹤其視覺化程度；將兩個代理合併為一個並使用所有工具和兩倍的輪次會損失 1.9 F1，因為它繼續搜索而不是閱讀；一個輪次預算掃描顯示在四個定位輪次時有一個步驟，並在此之後達到平臺；查詢延遲隨著模型調用而非語料庫大小而增長。我們將這三個索引基準作為只讀知識庫提供（免費註冊），並釋放所有提示和運行代碼：https://github.com/metask-ai/knowforge-bench
